evilwarrior_intro: ^A dark knight rises from a throne of broken blades, red light bleeding through cracked black plate.
^"You reek of hope. I will carve it out of you, one by one."
^Challenge him — "Face me, coward, if your armour lets you."
^Study him — watch how the cursed armour moves.

c-0: ^He roars and hauls his greatsword back, muscles coiling for a brutal opening blow.
c-1: ^The plate is thick — steel turns your blades — but it conducts: a storm would find the man inside.
c-2: ^The Evil Warrior fixes his gaze on your frailest hero. Battle is joined.
